_: Usage note per token, keyed by the CSS variable name without its leading dashes. Hand-maintained; build.mjs reports tokens that have no entry.
color-canvas: Page background (zinc-50 in light so white cards still read). `body` paints it.
color-surface: Sub-regions and the sidebar; the recessed CardPanel inside a Card; popovers.
color-card: Cards (`.neu-card`), context-menu panels and toasts: one just-perceptible step above the canvas, bordered with `color-border`.
color-elevated: Overlays and raised surfaces (`.neu-overlay`, dialogs), hover fills on ghost and outline buttons, inline code in notes.
color-text-primary: Headings, card and dialog titles, input text. On canvas, surface, card and elevated: 19:1 light, 16:1+ dark.
color-text-secondary: Default body copy (`body`), note prose, menu items, outline badges. 9.5:1+ on every surface in both themes.
color-text-muted: Descriptions, labels, ghost-button text, secondary badges. 7:1+ on every surface in both themes.
color-text-faint: Eyebrow section labels, placeholders, shortcut hints, timestamps. Light: 5.2:1+ on every surface. Dark, as shipped: 4.1:1 on canvas and 3.5:1 on elevated, under 4.5:1 for the 10px labels it carries.
color-accent: The one brand hue: primary buttons, links, focus ring, selected states, the accent badge. Light is darkened from the dark theme's #6467f2 so it clears 4.5:1 on zinc-50 (5.6:1 on canvas). Dark: 4.5:1 on canvas, 3.9:1 on elevated.
color-accent-hover: Hover fill of the default Button.
color-accent-subtle: 10% (16% dark) accent tint: accent badge fill, toast action button, info toast medallion, the new-case card on hover.
color-border: Hairline on cards, menu separators, step connectors, note blockquote rule, outline badges. Zinc-200 / zinc-800.
color-border-strong: Outline buttons, context-menu and toast panels, the CardPanel border, card hover border. Zinc-300 / OpenRouter input.
color-indigo-300: Raw palette step. Entity types, status indicators and one-offs only; prefer `color-accent` for UI.
color-indigo-400: Raw palette step. Entity types, status indicators and one-offs only.
color-indigo-500: Raw palette step. The hue behind the logo pulse keyframe.
color-amber-400: Raw palette step. Severity and integrity warnings.
color-amber-500: Raw palette step. The hue the warning status triple tints from.
color-emerald-400: Raw palette step. Also the dark-theme success foreground.
color-emerald-500: Raw palette step. The hue the success status triple tints from.
color-emerald-700: Raw palette step. Also the light-theme success foreground.
color-red-400: Raw palette step. Also the dark-theme danger foreground.
color-red-500: Raw palette step. The hue the danger status triple tints from; the shadcn `destructive` bridge.
color-red-600: Raw palette step. Fill of the destructive Button (white text, 4.8:1).
color-teal-500: Raw palette step. Entity and status one-offs.
color-violet-500: Mention entity hue (Selector). Exists so a chip references a token rather than a hex literal.
color-pink-500: Mention entity hue (tag fallback). Exists so a chip references a token rather than a hex literal.
color-success-surface: Success status fill: the 10% step of the tinted triple (fill / line / foreground), never a solid fill. Success badge, success toast medallion.
color-success-line: Success status border: the 20% step of the triple.
color-success-fg: Success text and icon on `color-success-surface`. Light is darkened two to three steps so 10-12px text clears 4.5:1 on the tint over canvas (5.2:1); dark lifts back to the bright hue (10:1).
color-danger-surface: Danger status fill (10% step). Danger badge, error toast medallion.
color-danger-fg: Danger text and icon on `color-danger-surface`; the `danger` context-menu item. 6.2:1 on canvas light, 7.2:1 dark.
color-warning-surface: Warning status fill (10% step). Warning badge, warning toast medallion.
color-warning-fg: Warning text and icon on `color-warning-surface`. 6.8:1 on canvas light, 11.9:1 dark.
color-hue-orange-fg: Categorical hue: the crypto case-type pill, orange in both themes. Light uses the 800 step because 700 landed at 4.28:1 on its tint over surface; 7:1 on canvas.
color-hue-sky-fg: Categorical hue: case-type pills and the NEW badge. 5.7:1 on canvas light, 7.2:1 dark.
color-hue-pink-fg: Categorical hue: case-type pills. 5.8:1 on canvas light, 5.6:1 dark.
color-slate-100: Raw slate step, reserved for severity and entity colours.
color-background: shadcn bridge: `bg-background` (active tab fill). Alias of `color-canvas`.
color-foreground: shadcn bridge: `text-foreground`, the tab trigger text and line indicator. Alias of `color-text-primary`.
color-primary-foreground: Text on `color-primary` / `color-accent`. 5.8:1 on the light accent; 4.4:1 on the dark theme's #6467f2, as shipped.
color-muted: shadcn bridge: `bg-muted`, the default TabsList track. Alias of `color-surface`.
color-muted-foreground: shadcn bridge: TabsList text. Alias of `color-text-muted`.
color-accent-foreground: shadcn bridge: text on an accent fill.
color-destructive-foreground: shadcn bridge: text on a destructive fill.
color-input: Border of Input and Textarea at rest (3.2:1 on canvas light); the border turns `color-accent` on focus.
color-ring: The keyboard focus ring: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid; outline-offset: 2px }` on every control that draws no ring of its own. Alias of `color-accent`.
shadow-card: Card at rest. Note `.neu-card` itself sets `box-shadow: none` and relies on its border.
shadow-card-hover: Card on hover; in practice the hover cue is the border turning `color-border-strong`.
shadow-overlay: Dialogs (`.neu-overlay`), the command palette and toasts: the one clearly raised step.
shadow-glow: The retired indigo glow. Resolves to none in both themes; keep it none.
shadow-btn: Default Button shadow. Resolves to none, which is why the button focus ring is an outline rather than a box-shadow ring.
d-itemy: Menu and list item vertical padding.
d-itemx: Menu and list item horizontal padding.
radius: The 6px ceiling: `rounded` and the Tailwind default. Cards, dialogs, toasts, the lg Button, tab lists.
radius-md: Buttons, inputs, textareas, context-menu panels, tab triggers, skeletons: the control radius.
radius-2xl: Aliases `radius` (6px) in the source: Card and DialogContent use `rounded-2xl` and land on 6px.
d-r: The density-aware radius slot. Declared once on :root as `var(--radius)`; no density step redeclares it.
